evidence.detail: Reviewed InteractHighlightPlugin rs/s/i/c stores rs/s/i/b as its only overlay, registers it with the live overlay manager during startup, clears its interaction state and unregisters it during shutdown.
InteractHighlightPlugin forwards only exact EntityInteraction and ObjectInteraction events into rs/s/i/b; no unrelated event family is delegated to this class.

rs/s/i/b owns reviewed InteractionHighlightConfig rs/s/i/a, whose exact v308 options cover NPC attack/hover/interact, Object hover/interact, show-on-hover/interact, outline colors, feather and border width.

The overlay inspects the current hovered menu row and renders only a different NPC or object target when the corresponding config toggle is enabled, using the configured NPC/object hover colors and shared outline renderer.

The overlay stores the current EntityInteraction/ObjectInteraction target, distinguishes NPC combat from non-combat interaction, applies the reviewed attack/interact colors, fades the highlight across its short lifetime, and clears state when the target expires or the player moves.

candidates.note: InteractHighlightOverlay is fixed by exclusive InteractHighlightPlugin ownership, exact EntityInteraction/ObjectInteraction forwarding, and a whole-class NPC/object hover/attack/interact render surface driven by InteractionHighlightConfig. Confidence is 0.999.
